observed_mismatches: The authored bell profiles read as radial caps with visible central openings instead of the reference's shallow, asymmetric twin-bell shells.
The body and dial remain over-faceted at the blockout stage and do not yet reproduce the reference's smooth rolled rim hierarchy.
The handle/bell attachment, hammer, legs, dial markings, rear controls, materials, and final surface treatment are absent; adding them would not repair the incorrect bell primary forms.
retained_learning: A same-target official multi-view source and depth check found an early axis/depth error before tertiary detail.
Curve handles must appear in diagnostic renders; the renderer now includes evaluated CURVE objects.
A closed profile should not be selected for a bell merely because it is rotationally convenient; its projected opening and rim silhouette must be checked first.
disposition_boundary: This rejection preserves the evidence for diagnosis. It is not a visual acceptance, production asset, or evidence of professional reference-modeling capability.
